name: @absolutejs/secure-messaging
description: Provider-neutral secure conversation orchestration for AbsoluteJS E2EE providers and untrusted delivery services.
author: Alex Kahn

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun build src/index.ts src/manifest.ts --outdir dist --root src --sourcemap --target=browser --external @absolutejs/e2ee --external '@absolutejs/e2ee/*' --external @absolutejs/manifest --external @sinclair/typebox && tsc --project tsconfig.build.json && absolute-manifest emit
scripts.check:package: bun run format:check && bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run build && bun run verify-package
scripts.release: bun run check:package && npm publish --access public
